name: Test

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]
  # Generated projects install the latest dependencies, so an upstream release can
  # break them with no change here. The daily run catches that on main first.
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 6 * * *"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: test-${{ github.head_ref || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  test:
    name: Test Suite
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version-file: package.json
          check-latest: true
          package-manager-cache: false

      - name: Setup Git user
        run: |
          git config --global user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config --global user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

      - name: Setup Bun
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: bun install --frozen-lockfile
        env:
          BTS_TELEMETRY: 0

      - name: Build CLI and Shared Packages
        run: bun run build:cli

      - name: Check Formatting and Lint
        run: bunx oxfmt --check . && bunx oxlint .

      - name: Check Source Types
        run: |
          bun run --filter create-better-t-stack check-types
          bun run --filter create-better-t-stack check-test-types
          bunx tsc --noEmit -p packages/template-generator/tsconfig.json
          bunx tsc --noEmit -p packages/backend/convex/tsconfig.json
          bun run --filter web check-types

      - name: Test Website Preview Integration
        run: bun test apps/web/test/preview.test.ts

      - name: Test CLI
        working-directory: apps/cli
        run: bun run test:ci
        env:
          AGENT: 1
          BTS_TELEMETRY: 0

  generated-builds:
    name: Generated Builds (${{ matrix.shard }}/8)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version-file: package.json
          check-latest: true
          package-manager-cache: false
      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
        with:
          version: 11
      - run: bun install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: bun run build:cli
      - name: Install, Build and Type-check Generated Projects
        working-directory: apps/cli
        run: bun test test/generated-builds.test.ts
        env:
          AGENT: 1
          BTS_TELEMETRY: 0
          BTS_BUILD_SAMPLES: 1
          BTS_BUILD_SAMPLE_SHARD: ${{ matrix.shard }}/8

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
